description: CSV to SQL — Turn a CSV into a ready-to-run SQL script: CREATE TABLE with inferred column types (integer, bigint, exact decimal precision/scale, float, boolean, date, timestamp with or without time zone, sized text) plus batched multi-row INSERTs in one transaction. dialect=postgres (default), mysql, sqlite or mssql with correct identifier quoting and literal escaping; table= name, primaryKey= (checked unique and non-null, otherwise left out with a warning), batch= rows per INSERT, dropIfExists=true, maxRows up to 20000. Column names become safe snake_case, leading-zero codes such as ZIPs stay text, NULL tokens (blank, NA, N/A, null) become NULL, and a primary key is suggested when one fits. Offline. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_to_sql
